definitions: A body of people presided over by a judge, judges, or magistrate, and acting as a tribunal in civil and criminal cases.
The place where legal trials take place.
A quadrangular area, either open or covered, marked out for playing a game such as tennis or basketball.
The residence of a sovereign or dignitary.
A retinue or entourage of a sovereign or dignitary.
examples: They went to court to settle the dispute.
She served an ace on the tennis court.
The royal court was in attendance.
He tried to gain favour at court.
